basic_profile.bio: I'm a 35-year-old graphic designer based in Nashville, Tennessee. I have a deep passion for music and gaming, often blending the two by creating fan art for my favorite games and bands. I'm particularly into the cyberpunk genre, with a special love for the aesthetic and music. Besides gaming, I attend music festivals like Bloodstock whenever I can. I'm married, and my partner shares my love for gaming and live music. I typically browse Reddit during the late evenings after work and on weekends. I enjoy discussing game lore and sharing fan theories, but I tend to avoid political debates as they often get heated.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong background in digital art and design, having studied graphic design at a local college. My love for music has been a lifelong journey, starting with a garage band in high school. Over the years, I've self-taught myself music theory and production, which allows me to appreciate the intricate details in soundtracks and bands like Samurai.
